intent: Create a Python CLI application for managing notes with add and view functionalities.
constraints: The application must be written in Python.
The application must be a CLI tool.
The application must support adding notes.
The application must support viewing notes.
expected_output: A Python CLI application that allows users to add and view notes.
success_criteria: The application can be successfully installed and run from the command line.
The application can add notes and store them persistently.
The application can retrieve and display stored notes.
